# The Marketing School
> The Marketing School teaches businesses to run profitable ads on Google, Meta, TikTok and LinkedIn, and installs AI in their ad accounts. It also offers the Dual Agent Build Pack: 12 live 1-on-1 build sessions to build a website, app, landing page, or project with AI (not a course). Done-for-you ads are available through Full Agency, by application.

## Offer 1: The Marketing School ads course ("Learn Ads. We Install the AI for You.")
- Price: $297/mo, locked in for 12 months. Or $2,497 paid up front, which saves $1,067.
- Includes: the full ads course (Google, Meta, TikTok and LinkedIn, step by step, from setup to scaling); a done-for-you AI install (we connect AI to your ad accounts to find wasted spend, write ads, and report results); an AI ad prompt pack; weekly live classes (Tuesday lead gen and Friday ads traffic, members only, not free); and a monthly account review.
- Optional add-ons (ask about pricing): ad creative (we make the images and videos for your ads) and CRM setup (so every lead gets followed up automatically).
- Who it is for: business owners and marketers who want to learn to run their own ads, with AI installed in their ad accounts, instead of hiring an agency.
- How to start: the "Lock in my spot" button opens a short lead form. There is no online checkout.
- Details: https://www.themarketingschool.com/#pricing and https://www.themarketingschool.com/ai-ads-course

## Offer 2: The Dual Agent Build Pack (not a course)
- What it is: 12 live 1-on-1 build sessions to build your site, app, landing page, or project with AI. It is not a course and not a training program.
- The dual agent method: one AI plans, writes, and reviews; a second AI builds; you approve each step.
- Who it is for: small business owners, or anyone starting a business. No developer or coding needed.
- Price: $297/mo, locked in for 12 months, with one live 1-on-1 session a month. Or $2,497 paid up front, which saves $1,067; upfront buyers can book the 12 sessions at their own pace, even weekly, and finish in about 3 months.
- How to start: the "Book my build pack" button opens a short lead form. There is no online checkout.
- Details: https://www.themarketingschool.com/dual-agent-build-pack

## Full Agency (done-for-you, apply only)
- We make the ads and run them: media buying on Google, Meta, TikTok, and LinkedIn, creative (static and video), a dedicated strategist, weekly 1:1 reporting, landing page and funnel builds.
- Price: $15,000/mo plus 10% of ad spend, 90-day minimum. Generally for accounts spending $30k+/mo.
- Details: https://www.themarketingschool.com/done-for-you-ads

## Free
- Free Ad Account Audit, via the free 3-minute Ad Account Score quiz: https://www.themarketingschool.com/assessment

## Founder
- Evan Baker, founder and instructor. Certified Google Ads expert with 20+ years running paid media on Google, Meta, YouTube, TikTok, and LinkedIn. Founded Crowdfunnel (raised $3M, grew to $20M in revenue); led strategy at DOE Media. Actively manages 100+ ad accounts and teaches the AI for Ads and AI for Lead Generation classes at BotBuilders (founded by Matt Leitz).

## How we work
- Grok Bot scans the Meta Ad Library for long-running competitor ads to find proven angles.
- Claude connects to Google and Meta ad accounts to audit search terms, placements, budgets, and tracking, and flags wasted spend fast.
- Evan reviews every finding and decides what to fix first; fixes go live quickly, and accounts keep being monitored.

## Proof
- $200M+ in ad spend managed over 20+ years.
- 150+ businesses served.
- One client went from $0 to $30k in profitable revenue with Google Ads.
- Public LinkedIn recommendations from Adam Foroughi (CEO, AppLovin; Evan's former manager), Navraj Sran (Google), Ramzey Nassar (Founder, DOE), John Narducci (client; scaled Google close to 7x), and Mark Murrell (Founder/CEO, Get Maine Lobster): https://www.linkedin.com/in/evanabaker/details/recommendations/
- Results are not guaranteed.
